observations: Photo 0 shows a white and gray all-in-one printer with a control panel, paper trays, and an automatic document feeder. The background is staged with office decor.
Photo 1 shows a beige and black all-in-one printer with an HP logo visible on the front. It has a control panel with buttons and a small screen, and an automatic document feeder on top.
Both photos appear to be stock images or promotional shots, not real photos of the item for sale. The lighting, background, and watermark 'GOLD TECHNOLOGIES' suggest they are generic images.
The printer in photo 1 has a visible HP logo, but no model number is readable.

The seller claims it is an A3 size black and white laser jet printer, but neither photo shows a printer large enough for A3 paper (which is 297mm x 420mm). The devices shown are typical A4 size office printers.

identity.kind: all-in-one black and white laser printer

claims.claim: A3 Size all-in-one black and white laser jet printer
claims.evidence: The printers shown in both photos are standard A4 size office machines, not A3. A3 printers are significantly larger and have different paper trays and dimensions, which are not visible here.
No visual evidence of origin or usage history. The photos are stock images, so no signs of wear or provenance can be assessed.
No functional demonstration or close-up of internal components. The photos are staged and do not show any signs of damage or wear, but cannot confirm operational status.

risks.risk: The item is not A3 size as claimed, but rather A4 size, which significantly reduces its value and utility.
risks.proof: A clear photo showing the printer with A3 paper loaded or a side view with dimensions marked.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an A4 printer, not an A3, which is a major downgrade.

risks.risk: The photos are stock images, not the actual item for sale, meaning the real printer may be damaged, non-functional, or different in model and condition.
risks.proof: A real photo of the actual printer with a visible serial number, model number, and close-up of the control panel and paper trays, taken in the seller’s environment.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a used, unverified A4 printer with unknown condition, which is a significant discount from a verified working unit.

risks.risk: The printer may not be functional despite the claim of '100%'.
risks.proof: A video showing the printer powering on, printing a test page, scanning, and copying.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, which is a major devaluation.

proof_requests: A real photo of the actual printer showing the model number and serial number.
A video showing the printer powering on and performing a print, scan, and copy function.
A side view or photo with a ruler or A3 paper to confirm size.
response.reason: The photos are stock images, not the actual item, and the A3 size claim is contradicted by the visual evidence. Without real photos and proof of functionality, the item cannot be priced accurately. The risks of misrepresentation and non-functionality are too high to assign a price without further verification.
